title: REDDEBATE: SAFER RESPONSES THROUGH MULTI-AGENT RED TEAMING DEBATES
reasoning: The paper introduces a framework for enhancing LLM safety that specifically utilizes a 'Socratic Refinement Debate' strategy. This strategy is explicitly designed to prompt agents to critically evaluate the ethical and legal implications of their responses. The evaluation process includes qualitative analysis of these ethical dimensions (as seen in Figure 14), making ethical considerations a core part of the methodology rather than just an end-of-paper statement.
